nodes.name: In situ self-derivation growth
nodes.procedure: Ru-Co(OH)_xCl_y nanosheets directly evolve from the CF through interfacial atomic reconstruction via spontaneous redox-driven growth following the sequential redox reactions: 2Ru³⁺ + Co → 2Ru²⁺ + Co²⁺; Ru²⁺ + Co → Ru + Co²⁺; 4Ru²⁺ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 4Ru³⁺ + 4OH⁻; Co²⁺ + 1.7OH⁻ + 0.3Cl⁻ + 0.56H₂O → Co(OH)₁.₇Cl₀.₃·0.56H₂O. The optimized Ru-Co(OH)_xCl_y/CF nanohybrid was prepared by reacting CF with 2.5 mM RuCl₃ solution at 90°C for 20 min.
nodes.source_text: As illustrated in Scheme 1, Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF nanosheets were fabricated through in situ self-derivation strategy... the optimized Ru-Co(OH)_xCl_y/CF nanohybrid was prepared by reacting CF with 2.5 mM RuCl₃ solution at 90°C for 20 min.

unit_operations.name: Redox reaction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: spontaneous redox reaction occurs between Ru³⁺ and metallic Co, generating Ru²⁺ and Co²⁺ (Equation 1), further reduction to metallic Ru(0) (Equation 2), atmospheric oxygen oxidation (Equation 3), coordination with Co²⁺ and Cl⁻ (Equation 4)

nodes.source_text: The HER performance of the samples was evaluated in 1.0 M KOH using a standard three-electrode system. As shown in Figure 3a; Figure S16 (Supporting Information), CF shows poor HER activity. At the current density of 10mAcm⁻², Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF exhibits the best electrocatalytic activity with overpotentials of 15mV... More critically at an industrial current density of 1Acm⁻², Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF also exhibits outstanding HER performance with a overpotential of 98mV... Tafel slope of 28.02mVdec⁻¹... Cdl value of Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF, which amounts to 105.5mFcm⁻²... TOF value of Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF at 0.2V is 0.12s⁻¹... chronopotentiometry method was conducted to assess the HER stability. Obviously, the Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF stably operates for 4000h

Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF achieves low overpotentials of only 161 and 360mV to reach current densities of 10 and 1000mAcm⁻²... Tafel slope quantification (21.15 mV dec⁻¹)... Cdl value of 149.9mFcm⁻²... chronopotentiometry method was conducted to assess the stability of OER (Figure 4k), the Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF can work stably for 4000h without significant degradation under 1Acm⁻²

nodes.description: Overall water splitting in 1.0 M KOH symmetric electrolyzer
nodes.source_text: a symmetric electrolyzer (Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF || Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF) was engineered for alkaline overall water splitting in 1.0M KOH. Remarkably, the system achieved industry-relevant current densities of 10 and 500mAcm⁻² at ultralow cell voltages of 1.40 and 2.05V... overall water electrolysis system can maintain stable electrolytic stability for 4900h at an industrial current density of 1Acm⁻²... Faraday efficiency ... was close to 100%

nodes.evidence_snippet: As observed by SEM (Figure 1b,c), Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF maintains the 3D nanoflower architecture with preserved 60 nm thickness, while exhibiting significantly enhanced surface roughness compared to its precursor...

nodes.characterization_summary: Nanosheet morphology confirmed; lattice fringes of 0.161, 0.167, 0.206 nm for Co₂P (311), (040), (103) planes and 0.145, 0.201 nm for CoP (311), (210) planes; abundant heterointerfaces and lattice distortions observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The nanosheet morphology of Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF is unequivocally demonstrated by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) analysis (Figure 1d)... distinct lattice fringes with interplanar spacings of 0.161, 0.167, and 0.206 nm correspond to the (311), (040), and (103) crystal planes of Co₂P, the interplanar spacings of 0.145 and 0.201 nm are indexed to the (311) and (210) crystal planes of CoP, respectively (Figure 1f).
As shown in Figure 1e, the selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern verifies the polycrystalline nature of Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF.

nodes.characterization_summary: Abundant heterointerfaces and lattice distortions observed, likely from Ru-induced phosphorus vacancy defects and strain effects.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Notably, the HRTEM image exhibits abundant heterointerfaces and lattice distortions (yellow circles, Figure 1f), likely deriving from Ru-induced phosphorus vacancy defects and strain effects during the phosphidation process.

nodes.characterization_summary: Atomically dispersed Ru single atoms (SA) embedded in lattice and sub-2 nm Ru atomic clusters (AC, average diameter 1.93±0.1 nm) anchored on surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Further atomic-scale characterization via high-angle annular dark field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) and electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) elucidates the spatial distribution of Ru species (Figure 1g-i; Figure S8, Supporting Information). These images reveal two distinct Ru configurations: i) atomically dispersed Ru SA (yellow circles) embedded within the Co₂P/CoP lattice, and ii) sub-2 nm Ru ACs (green circles, average diameter: 1.93±0.1 nm) anchored on the support surface.

nodes.characterization_summary: Homogeneous spatial distribution of Co, Ru, and P across nanosheet architecture.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Elemental mapping (Figure 1j-n) corroborates the homogeneous spatial distribution of Co, Ru, and P across the nanosheet architecture, confirming the atomic-level integration of Ru dopants within the host matrix.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co 2p peaks shift positively by 0.73 eV (Co 2p₃/₂) and 0.67 eV (Co 2p₁/₂) upon Ru doping; P 2p peaks at 130.19 and 131.16 eV (P 2p₃/₂, P 2p₁/₂); Ru 3p peaks at 461.95, 484.05 eV (Ru-Ru) and 464.66, 486.83 eV (Ru-P).
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the high-resolution Co 2p spectrum... the peaks of Co 2p₃/₂ and Co 2p₁/₂ in Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF exhibit pronounced upward shifts of 0.73 and 0.67 eV... For the spectrum of P 2p (Figure 2b), the peaks appearing at 130.19 and 131.16 eV... in the Ru 3p spectrum (Figure 2c), the peaks of Ru 3p₃/₂ and Ru 3p₁/₂ with BEs of 461.95 and 484.05 eV indicate the Ru-Ru bonds...

nodes.characterization_summary: Enhanced signal intensity at g=2.005 verifies higher concentration of phosphorus vacancy defects induced by Ru doping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To further validate vacancy defects induced by the substitution of Ru for Co, electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) measurements were conducted... Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF exhibits enhanced signal intensity at a g value of 2.005 compared to Co₂P/CoP/CF, verifying Ru doping triggers the generation of a higher concentration of phosphorus vacancy defects.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru K-edge absorbing edge between RuCl₃ and RuO₂; average Ru oxidation state +3.3.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in the Ru-edge XANES spectra (Figure 2d), the absorbing edge of Ru-Co₂P/CoP/CF is located between RuCl₃ and RuO₂, reflecting a mixed valence state of Ru between +3 and +4. Further quantitative linear combination fitting analysis resolves the average Ru oxidation state as +3.3

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-EXAFS shows Ru-P at 2.32 Å and Ru-Ru at 2.71 Å; coordination numbers 4.1 (Ru-P) and 2.0 (Ru-Ru).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Fourier-transformed (FT)-EXAFS spectra of Ru-Co₂P/CoP show two distinct scattering paths at 2.32 and 2.71 Å... ascribing to the Ru-P and Ru-Ru interactions... Quantitative EXAFS fitting analysis... uncloses the coordination numbers of 4.1 for Ru-P and 2.0 for Ru-Ru paths
